assets.name: wheel
assets.label: 4기생 관람차 입구
assets.desc: Entrance to Gen4 Ferris wheel, not the actual whole wheel structure. Central dark purple metal ticket gate double doors. assets.name: clock

assets.desc: Entrance to Promise clock tower, no whole tower. Center navy steel double doors with slim dull brass trims. Left panel a LARGE CREAM ROUND CLOCK with bold navy hands and four ticks, about20px diameter, only clock sign not tower. No height above wall.
